scientific_integrity: The complete finite matching and signed integral Morse differential are recomputed by a self-contained exact Python verifier. Existing mod-two homology information is credited as prior work, not recast as new. This same-model review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: A finite exact result for the ordinary matching complex of a single explicitly defined twenty-vertex graph. No uniform, equivariant or graph-family-wide classification is claimed. Potential unindexed equivalent results cannot be completely excluded.
title: The Desargues matching complex is a mixed-dimensional wedge of spheres
